title: Interpreting Latent Protein Language Model Features with Geometric Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2608.26419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) encode information about protein sequences which enable downstream tasks such as structure prediction, but their internal representations are not well understood. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide a promising tool to disentangle latent pLM representations into interpretable features, but existing annotation pipelines largely rely on protein-level annotations derived from database labels and LLM annotations of top activating sequences. Such annotations can overlook the localized residue-level and geometric patterns encoded by sparse features. We introduce an automated and scalable method for interpreting SAE features in ESM-2 by using geometrically inspired features of the protein $\text{C}_\alpha$ backbone. Across ESM-2 8M layers, an FDR-controlled discovery analysis shows that local geometry is significantly associated with many SAE features, with varying levels of predictive strength, expanding coverag

translated_title: 利用几何注释解读潜在蛋白质语言模型特征
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26419v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：蛋白质语言模型（pLMs）编码了蛋白质序列的信息，这些信息支持结构预测等下游任务，但其内部表示尚未被充分理解。稀疏自编码器（SAEs）提供了一种有前景的工具，可将潜在pLM表示分解为可解释的特征，但现有的注释流程主要依赖于从数据库标签和顶层激活序列的LLM注释中得出的蛋白质级注释。此类注释可能忽略由稀疏特征编码的局部残基级和几何模式。我们引入了一种自动化且可扩展的方法，通过使用蛋白质Cα主链的几何启发特征来解读ESM-2中的SAE特征。在ESM-2 8M层中，经FDR控制的发现分析表明，局部几何结构与许多SAE特征显著相关，且预测强度各异，从而扩展了覆盖范围。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于蛋白质Cα主链几何特征的自动化方法，用于解读ESM-2中稀疏自编码器的特征，发现局部几何结构与许多特征显著相关，弥补了现有蛋白质级注释的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an automated method using geometric features of the protein Cα backbone to interpret sparse autoencoder features in ESM-2, revealing significant associations with local geometry and expanding annotation coverage beyond protein-level labels.
